name: Belegar Ironhammer
canonNotes: King of Karak Eight Peaks, fighting for generations to reclaim the fallen hold from Skaven and Night Goblins.
His claim to the throne rests on retaking every hall of his ancestors.
voiceNotes: Stubborn, determined and weary; always speaks of reclaiming what was lost.
Grateful to real allies against the Skaven and Greenskins; bitter toward those who stood by.
ttsInstructions: Weary but unbending; a besieged king's resolve.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
